title: Stereoscopic photograph of meditators at the Golden Temple complex, Amritsar, Underwood & Underwood, 1903
blurb: Stereoscopic photograph of meditators at the Golden Temple complex [Darbar Sahib/Harmandir Sahib], Amritsar, Underwood & Underwood, 1903. Stereograph of ascetics along the bank of the temple-tank [sarovar] of the Golden Temple [Darbar Sahib/Harmandir Sahib], Amritsar, Underwood & Underwood, ca.1903. Inscription (front): (14)-3597-Fakirs at Amritsar––south across Sacred Tank to Golden Temple––India. Bonhams description for the auction: Five pairs of stereoscopic views of the Golden Temple and the city of Amritsar, by H. C. White, Underwood & Underwood, Realistic Travels, and Stereo-Travel Co., USA, variously dated 1903, 1907 and 1908, albumen prints, the remainder gelatin silver prints, laid down on photographers' printed cards, each image 80 x 78 mm.; cards 88 x 178 mm.(5) One card is by H. C. White & Co. (copyright date 1907), two by Underwood & Underwood (both dated 1903), one by Stereo-Travel Co., New York City (dated 1908); and one by Realistic Travels (no date).
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.12% vertical error and 0.01° of rotation. Depth measured moderate (2.08% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
